title: Mindset Of A Leader, Actions Of A King
body:
IUIC in the ClassRoom · 2026-03-21

Opens [1 Cor 14](/bible/1-corinthians/14) · [Rev 12](/bible/revelation/12) · [Ps 94](/bible/psalms/94) · [Matt 2](/bible/matthew/2) · [Deut 7](/bible/deuteronomy/7) · [2 Sam 7](/bible/2-samuel/7) · [Deut 4](/bible/deuteronomy/4) · [1 Pet 2](/bible/1-peter/2) · [Isa 42](/bible/isaiah/42) · [Sir 44](/bible/sirach/44) · [Job 33](/bible/job/33) · [1 Macc 2](/bible/1-maccabees/2) · [Matt 4](/bible/matthew/4) · [Ezra 1](/bible/ezra/1) · [Phlm 1](/bible/philemon/1) · [Neh 4](/bible/nehemiah/4) · and 8 more below
## Introduction *[[9:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=584s)]* A Sabbath class from the Florida captains on the mindset of a leader and the actions of a king. It opens with a side class on the war overseas: America's military might, NATO turning on the beast, and the way Esau wages war by taking out the leaders first, which is why every man in Israel must be built to step in. The class then lays out what makes a leader: a chosen, peculiar people with the law as their wisdom; a leader who believes he can get the job done and says send me; who invites others and builds leaders better than himself; who serves the people rather than asking for rank; who transfers his faith and strengthens the brethren; and who leads by example as one that serves. ## In The News - *[[10:23](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=623s)]* **Trump says America is the strongest nation with the strongest military and does not need the allies, but is testing who will show up.** — By thy sword shalt thou live, Genesis 27:40. America is showcasing exactly the military the Bible said Esau would live by. Eight countries bombed in a few months, and social media now lets you see what was hidden when Obama dropped a bomb every day of his term. - *[[18:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=1090s)]* **A commentator lists America's air forces and navies as the most powerful in history, then says its enemies use fifth generation warfare to divide races, sexes, and families.** — Daniel 2:40-43. The fourth kingdom is strong as iron in its military but mixed with miry clay, partly strong and partly broken, because it mingles itself with the seed of men and they do not cleave together. No other nation has that problem because no other nation has all nations and all religions inside it. - *[[24:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=1466s)]* **Trump threatens to end NATO if the allies do not help reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Germany, Japan, and China decline, and China now pays Iran for oil in yuan.** — The financial impact of the war is spreading across the whole world while America's allies quietly stop answering. - *[[25:33](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=1533s)]* **Twenty-eight European nations sign a security alliance designed to function without the United States, after 75 years of Western security built on American leadership since the atomic bomb.** — Revelation 17:12-18. The ten horns are NATO, one mind with the beast since 1945, giving their power and strength to it. Now they shall hate the whore, make her desolate, and burn her with fire, which is the nuclear weapons coming to America, because God put it in their hearts to fulfil his will. - *[[39:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=2374s)]* **Trump says Iran's navy, air force, radar, and leaders are all gone, and the next set of leaders too, so there is nobody left to talk to.** — This is how the white man wages war: cut the head and the body falls. It is a message to us. Any 10 or 50 could be over the whole congregation tomorrow, so every city must operate as its own headquarters. Iran kept firing after its leaders were killed because it planned independently after watching Iraq. - *[[1:17:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=4640s)]* **The Great Debaters scene where the professor describes Willie Lynch's method: keep the slave physically strong but psychologically weak, keep the body and take the mind.** — That is where our people are, a decayed estate. It is why the bishops and deacons teach with urgency in the streets: 99 percent of our people are in a horrible state of mind. - *[[1:22:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=4950s)]* **The Django scene where Stephen says he is that one in ten thousand.** — Job 33:23, one among a thousand. That is you. When you show up on the job or anywhere else, your mindset is not to fit in but to make it better, like Joseph in Egypt. - *[[1:54:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=6892s)]* **A business owner says everything rises and falls on leadership, period, and the best leaders build the best franchises.** — Sirach 10:2. As the judge of the people is, so are his officers. Change the leader in a city and the camp takes off. That is why everyone interviews the Bishop for the secret sauce, but Christ is at the head and the Most High is building 144,000 leaders. - *[[2:19:27](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=8367s)]* **Good leaders make you believe in them; great leaders make you believe in you.** — Hebrews 13:7, whose faith follow. That is how the Bishop raises up bishops, deacons, captains, and soldiers by the thousands. - *[[2:25:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=8713s)]* **A speaker on leadership: when you are junior you only have to be good at your job, then you are promoted to be responsible for the people who do the job you used to do, and nobody shows you how. You are not in charge; you are responsible for those in your charge.** — In the truth you start editing the video or working the kitchen, then you are over the brothers who do it. Everybody is not built for that level, but there are things you can learn. ## Scriptures Opened **[1 Corinthians 14:1](/bible/1-corinthians/14#v1)** *[[16:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=1001s)]* > [1](/bible/1-corinthians/14#v1) Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy. - Follow after charity and desire spiritual gifts. Desire the gift you see in a brother's charity, building, editing, public dealing, or event ordering. - But rather that ye may prophesy. That is why the class deals with prophecy first. A captain adds that the purpose of prophecy is to build your spirit and prepare you for temptation and destruction; when you see these things come to pass, know that Esau, Edom, America, is the enemy the Bible speaks of. Precepts: - **[Habakkuk 2:3](/bible/habakkuk/2#v3)** > [3](/bible/habakkuk/2#v3) For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry. The vision is for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie; though it tarry, wait for it. What is read in Revelation is guaranteed. Wait for it is the counsel to the elect. - **[Revelation 18:2-4](/bible/revelation/18#v2)** > [2](/bible/revelation/18#v2) And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird. > > [3](/bible/revelation/18#v3) For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies. > > [4](/bible/revelation/18#v4) And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues. Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins. Come out of religion, Christianity, and the philosophies and deceit, and repent. - **[Isaiah 47:1-3](/bible/isaiah/47#v1)** > [1](/bible/isaiah/47#v1) Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate. > > [2](/bible/isaiah/47#v2) Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers. > > [3](/bible/isaiah/47#v3) Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man. Come down and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon. America has never been touched, so she is the virgin; 9/11 was a controlled demolition. Now uncover the locks and make bare the leg: her nakedness is being uncovered as she allies with the little Satan and bombs other nations. **[Revelation 12:17](/bible/revelation/12#v17)** *[[41:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=2512s)]* > [17](/bible/revelation/12#v17) And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ. - The dragon was wroth with the woman and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments and have the testimony of Jesus Christ. - He knows exactly where we are. We pay for his internet, use his GPS, and ask his AI everything. That is how he goes to war: attack the leaders. So every man must be built up to step in for the next man. - Every leader who stood up for our people, even not knowing they were Israelites, was murdered: King, Malcolm, Hampton, Evers, Garvey. We already know the tactic; the last week showed it again. **[Psalms 94:16](/bible/psalms/94#v16)** *[[44:53](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=2693s)]* > [16](/bible/psalms/94#v16) Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity? - Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? The Most High is looking for those who will stand up. You are not a leader when everything is good; a leader is needed when the president is dead and the country is being bombed. That is where we are spiritually as a nation. **[Matthew 2:1-16](/bible/matthew/2#v1)** *[[46:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=2790s)]* > [1](/bible/matthew/2#v1) Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem, > > [2](/bible/matthew/2#v2) Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him. > > [3](/bible/matthew/2#v3) When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him. > > [4](/bible/matthew/2#v4) And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born. > > [5](/bible/matthew/2#v5) And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judea: for thus it is written by the prophet, > > [6](/bible/matthew/2#v6) And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel. > > [7](/bible/matthew/2#v7) Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared. > > [8](/bible/matthew/2#v8) And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also. > > [9](/bible/matthew/2#v9) When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was. > > [10](/bible/matthew/2#v10) When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy. > > [11](/bible/matthew/2#v11) And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh. > > [12](/bible/matthew/2#v12) And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way. > > [13](/bible/matthew/2#v13) And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him. > > [14](/bible/matthew/2#v14) When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt: > > [15](/bible/matthew/2#v15) And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son. > > [16](/bible/matthew/2#v16) Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men. - Herod, an Edomite, heard of one born King of the Jews, a governor to rule my people Israel. Esau is threatened whenever his people have a leader other than him. - When the wise men mocked him he slew all the children in Bethlehem, killing everyone who could potentially fill the spot, exactly as with Iran. The spirit in this man has not changed, and blood will come to him. - Everyone in this room or watching has the spirit of a leader in him. You could be at the soccer game or the door buster, but God called you here to get yourself together, and that alone sets you up to lead in the coming kingdom and now. Leadership is taught; you must apply yourself. **[Deuteronomy 7:6](/bible/deuteronomy/7#v6)** *[[49:40](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=2980s)]* > [6](/bible/deuteronomy/7#v6) For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God: the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth. - Thou art an holy people; the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people above all people on the earth. If you wear fringes and understand the Sabbath, you are in the top fraction of the earth and a leader the second you walk into your job. - In sports the special one usually leads because of a talent. Your talent is keeping God's commandments, wisdom and understanding nobody else has. Above all people does not sound like followers. We follow Christ and the leaders, not the nations. **[2 Samuel 7:23](/bible/2-samuel/7#v23)** *[[52:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=3131s)]* > [23](/bible/2-samuel/7#v23) And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, from the nations and their gods? - What one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel? We were brought here chained, unable to read or write, and still figured it out and rebelled again and again. The white man has every advantage and still ends up a vagabond. **[Deuteronomy 4:5-8](/bible/deuteronomy/4#v5)** *[[54:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=3275s)]* > [5](/bible/deuteronomy/4#v5) Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the Lord my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it. > > [6](/bible/deuteronomy/4#v6) Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people. > > [7](/bible/deuteronomy/4#v7) For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the Lord our God is in all things that we call upon him for? > > [8](/bible/deuteronomy/4#v8) And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day? - I have taught you statutes and judgments; keep and do them, for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations. We get the cheat code nobody else can tap into, which makes great judges and leaders. - Many of you lose all your wisdom the second you are around anybody without fringes. That is what separates you; the spirit on you is what elevated Daniel and Joseph in the heathen's kingdom. - Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people. Only a third will repent, but those keeping the commandments were not set up to collect dust. Lead in your household, your office, your twenty men, the sisters you teach, the city, in whatever capacity. - Every leadership book is based on the Bible. They get the watered-down version; we get the pure concentrate. And yet they run the leadership conferences and make billions while we are at the bottom. **[1 Peter 2:9](/bible/1-peter/2#v9)** *[[59:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=3562s)]* > [9](/bible/1-peter/2#v9) But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light: - Ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people. This is written to Israelites, not to white Grecians in togas. - You were called out of darkness to show forth his praise. Nobody puts a light under a bushel. You shine from the front, so it is time to take your places. Precepts: - **[Wisdom of Solomon 19:6](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/19#v6)** > [6](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/19#v6) For the whole creature in his proper kind was fashioned again anew, serving the peculiar commandments that were given unto them, that thy children might be kept without hurt: The whole creature was fashioned again anew, serving the peculiar commandments that were given unto them. The fringes, the beard, and the Sabbath are what separate you, and they were given only to us. **[Isaiah 42:21](/bible/isaiah/42#v21)** *[[1:02:32](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=3752s)]* > [21](/bible/isaiah/42#v21) The Lord is well pleased for his righteousness’ sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable. - The Lord is well pleased for his righteousness' sake; he will magnify the law. Standing firm for the laws of God automatically puts you in a different position from everyone on earth. - A brother asked how to do better at his job; try to be the manager, because the way you do anything is the way you do everything, and the managers over you are usually no better than you. - Houston had to impose a regional dress code because the women could not dress themselves, while our sisters dress modestly. On the cruise, fifty men reading the Bible were the disturbance among men trying to get drunk; they make a man an offender for the word, but if something happened on that ship they would come to the Bible-loving men for help. **[Sirach 44:1-8](/bible/sirach/44#v1)** *[[1:05:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=3917s)]* > [1](/bible/sirach/44#v1) Let us now praise famous men, and our fathers that begat us. > > [2](/bible/sirach/44#v2) The Lord hath wrought great glory by them through his great power from the beginning. > > [3](/bible/sirach/44#v3) Such as did bear rule in their kingdoms, men renowned for their power, giving counsel by their understanding, and declaring prophecies: > > [4](/bible/sirach/44#v4) Leaders of the people by their counsels, and by their knowledge of learning meet for the people, wise and eloquent are their instructions: > > [5](/bible/sirach/44#v5) Such as found out musical tunes, and recited verses in writing: > > [6](/bible/sirach/44#v6) Rich men furnished with ability, living peaceably in their habitations: > > [7](/bible/sirach/44#v7) All these were honoured in their generations, and were the glory of their times. > > [8](/bible/sirach/44#v8) There be of them, that have left a name behind them, that their praises might be reported. - Let us now praise famous men: men renowned for their power, giving counsel by their understanding, declaring prophecies. Leaders, plural. We are a nation of leaders; the law and the prophets were many. - By their knowledge of learning meet for the people: just what the people needed in that time and place. Some found out musical tunes, some recited verses in writing, so the brothers in music and the captains and sisters writing books are leaders in their facet. - Rich men furnished with ability, living peaceably in their habitations, able to calm the area around them like David and Solomon. They left a name behind so their praises might be reported; the Bible, the best-selling book every year, is the record of their leadership. - A captain adds that we are compared to fine gold, which has to be mined, so do not be afraid of perfection or of being great. A leader is needed to bring comfort to a people that has been robbed, raped, and murdered. Precepts: - **[2 Maccabees 15:9-17](/bible/2-maccabees/15#v9)** > [9](/bible/2-maccabees/15#v9) And so comforting them out of the law and the prophets, and withal putting them in mind of the battles that they won afore, he made them more cheerful. > > [10](/bible/2-maccabees/15#v10) And when he had stirred up their minds, he gave them their charge, shewing them therewithal the falsehood of the heathen, and the breach of oaths. > > [11](/bible/2-maccabees/15#v11) Thus he armed every one of them, not so much with defence of shields and spears, as with comfortable and good words: and beside that, he told them a dream worthy to be believed, as if it had been so indeed, which did not a little rejoice them. > > [12](/bible/2-maccabees/15#v12) And this was his vision: That Onias, who had been high priest, a virtuous and a good man, reverend in conversation, gentle in condition, well spoken also, and exercised from a child in all points of virtue, holding up his hands prayed for the whole body of the Jews. > > [13](/bible/2-maccabees/15#v13) This done, in like manner there appeared a man with gray hairs, and exceeding glorious, who was of a wonderful and excellent majesty. > > [14](/bible/2-maccabees/15#v14) Then Onias answered, saying, This is a lover of the brethren, who prayeth much for the people, and for the holy city, to wit, Jeremias the prophet of God. > > [15](/bible/2-maccabees/15#v15) Whereupon Jeremias holding forth his right hand gave to Judas a sword of gold, and in giving it spake thus, > > [16](/bible/2-maccabees/15#v16) Take this holy sword, a gift from God, with the which thou shalt wound the adversaries. > > [17](/bible/2-maccabees/15#v17) Thus being well comforted by the words of Judas, which were very good, and able to stir them up to valour, and to encourage the hearts of the young men, they determined not to pitch camp, but courageously to set upon them, and manfully to try the matter by conflict, because the city and the sanctuary and the temple were in danger. Judas Maccabeus comforted the people out of the law and the prophets, put them in mind of the battles they had won before, and when he had stirred up their minds gave them their charge, showing the falsehood of the heathen and their breach of oaths. His vision was of Onias the high priest, a virtuous and good man, reverend in conversation, gentle in condition, well spoken, exercised from a child in virtue, praying for the whole body of the Jews. Take this holy sword and wound the adversaries; the people were well comforted by his words and set to try the matter manfully. A leader knows the condition of the battle, comforts out of the scriptures, and reworks the minds of children who still think Esau is a princess. - **[1 Maccabees 3:43](/bible/1-maccabees/3#v43)** > [43](/bible/1-maccabees/3#v43) They said one to another, Let us restore the decayed fortune of our people, and let us fight for our people and the sanctuary. They said one to another, let us restore the decayed estate of our people, and let us fight for our people and the sanctuary. Nobody did it alone; the Bishop went to the streets with a reader. You will go further and sacrifice more for someone else than for yourself, which is why selfish people only go so far. **[Job 33:23](/bible/job/33#v23)** *[[1:21:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=4904s)]* > [23](/bible/job/33#v23) If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness: - If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand. You are that one, and that makes you a leader. Anywhere you step in, your mindset is not to fit in but to make it better. - The first mark of a leader's mindset: he believes he can get the job done. When an issue arises you do not run; you raise your hand, volunteer, and find the solution. Precepts: - **[Isaiah 6:8](/bible/isaiah/6#v8)** > [8](/bible/isaiah/6#v8) Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me. Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Here am I; send me. That is the mindset of a leader, the same as David asking where Goliath was while everyone else cried about the situation. **[1 Maccabees 2:19-27](/bible/1-maccabees/2#v19)** *[[1:25:31](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U7sjvP8Tio4&t=5131s)]* > [19](/bible/1-maccabees/2#v19) Then Mattathias answered and spake with a loud voice, Though all the nations that are under the king’s dominion obey him, and fall away every one from the religion of their fathers, and give consent to his commandments: > > [20](/bible/1-maccabees/2#v20) Yet will I and my sons and my brethren walk in the covenant of our fathers. > > [21](/bible/1-maccabees/2#v21) God forbid that we should forsake the law and the ordinances. > > [22](/bible/1-maccabees/2#v22) We will not hearken to the king’s words, to go from our religion, either on the right hand, or the left. > > [23](/bible/1-maccabees/2#v23) Now when he had left speaking these words, there came one of the Jews in the sight of all to sacrifice on the altar which was at Modin, according to the king’s commandment. > > [24](/bible/1-maccabees/2#v24) Which thing when Mattathias saw, he was inflamed with zeal, and his reins trembled, neither could he forbear to shew his anger according to judgment: wherefore he ran, and slew him upon the altar. > > [25](/bible/1-maccabees/2#v25) Also the king’s commissioner, who compelled men to sacrifice, he killed at that time, and the altar he pulled down. > > [26](/bible/1-maccabees/2#v26) Thus dealt he zealously for the law of God like as Phinees did unto Zambri the son of Salom. > > [27](/bible/1-maccabees/2#v27) And Mattathias cried throughout the city with a loud voice, saying, Whosoever is zealous of the law, and maintaineth the covenant, let him follow me. - You have to see it before you see it. Before anything happens you visualize it, whether graduating, marrying, or getting a job. Mattathias saw two realities, one where his children ate swine like everybody else and one where they fought and won, and refused the first. - Though all nations obey the king, yet will I and my sons walk in the covenant of our fathers. Religion is keeping the commandments; God forbid we forsake the law. - When a Jew sacrificed at Modin he was inflamed with zeal, slew him on the altar, killed the king's commissioner, pulled down the altar, and cried, whosoever is zealous of the law, let him follow me. Somebody had to stand up. - That is the decision the bishops made years ago with no internet, no YouTube, no followers: we cannot go to the Christian church again, come to the basement. And each of you made the same decision to drive three hours or tune in. It is easy to follow; you decided to lead. - A captain adds: remember your first confidence, when you gave up the church, the pants, the pork, and Christmas, and faith led you to a safe haven at Bishop Cannan's table.
